verdict.rationale: The only on-point evidence is that Paxos API credentials (Client ID/Secret) can be limited to specific endpoints via allowed scopes, plus programmatic identity creation and transfer APIs. Nothing shows wallets issued per agent or limits on what an agent can move. Missing for 10: programmatic per-agent wallet issuance, spend/transfer policy controls, documented movement limits for agents, and any agent-specific safety guidance or independent corroboration.
